rows.ja: 共同開発・ロイヤルティの相手

companies.name: ジョンソン・エンド・ジョンソン

relations.text: ダラザレックスをJ&Jに独占ライセンスしロイヤルティを受け取る
relations.text_en: Licenses Darzalex exclusively to J&J and earns royalties

source.label: Genmab 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Daratumumab is being developed and commercialized by J&J under an exclusive worldwide license from Genmab

relations.text: 血液がん薬エプコリタマブをAbbVieと共同開発・販売
relations.text_en: Develops and sells epcoritamab with AbbVie

source.label: Genmab 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Epcoritamab, marketed as EPKINLY in countries including the US and Japan and as TEPKINLY in the EU, is being developed and commercialized in collaboration with AbbVie.

relations.text: 子宮頸がん薬Tivdakを共同開発・米国で共同販売
relations.text_en: Co-develops Tivdak and co-promotes it in the US with Pfizer

source.label: Genmab 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Tivdak is being co- developed globally and co-promoted in the US in collaboration with Pfizer

relations.text: Roche経由でTEPEZZAの売上に応じたロイヤルティを受け取る
relations.text_en: Earns royalties on TEPEZZA sales under its agreement with Roche

source.label: Genmab 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Under the terms of Genmab's agreement with Roche, Genmab receives a mid-single digit royalty on net sales of TEPEZZA

relations.text: 二重特異性抗体を共同研究・開発(2015年)
relations.text_en: Jointly researches and develops bispecific antibodies (2015)

source.label: Genmab 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: In May 2015, we entered into an agreement with BioNTech to jointly research, develop and commercialize bispecific antibody products using our DuoBody technology platform and antibodies.
